title: SKE CL2000 Strawberry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill - 20mg
description: Strawberry Ice brings sweet, sun-ripened Strawberry with a brisk Menthol chill for a classic fruit-and-ice mix. It’s a straightforward, refreshing blend that suits any time of day. Each CL2000 replacement pack contains a 1.8ml prefilled pod and a 2.2ml refill container. Click them together, fit to your CL2000 device and enjoy consistent flavour from the mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, with up to 2000 puffs per pack depending on use. To replace: remove seals, click the pod and refill together, then push the assembled unit into the device until it locks. When both sections are empty, dispose of them responsibly and fit a fresh CL2000 pod + refill.
